text:
olivia_r: heads up — saw ~220 unassigned leads in HS last 6h, looks like enrichment timeouts. @raj_s can you confirm? :eyes:

enrich-bot: alert — enrichment_queue_error rate=24/hr, avg_latency=12s, fail_rate=18% (since 02:10 UTC)

raj_s: confirming, we saw higher dead-letter counts. workaround used yesterday (default-owner fallback) wasn't applied to the new SF mapping.

maria_m: timeline? is this causing SDRs to miss handoffs? any SLA breaches?

olivia_r: yes - some leads are >1h unassigned; SLA is 15m. SDRs pinging #sales about lost convos.

noah_e: quick theory — the enrichment service started returning 503s after HubSpot webhook schema changed (custom field renamed). KV cache failed to map SF owner id -> hs owner.

raj_s: would a soft-fallback help? e.g. if enrichment fails after 3 retries use rotation owner or pool "inbound-temp".

noah_e: yes. I can push a patch to enr-proxy to add fallback: 
```
if (enrich.failures >= 3) {
  assignOwner = rotation.pick('inbound-temp')
}
```
I'll also add metric tag "fallback_assigned".

maria_m: that would reduce SLA misses fast. Can we also add an HS workflow to claim if unassigned > 10m? low-risk.

raj_s: +1. I'll add a temporary HubSpot workflow that assigns to "inbound-temp" after 10m and notifies owner channel.

olivia_r: timeline? prefer rollback rather than wait for full release.

noah_e: I can do a hotfix to enr-proxy and feature flag it — deploy in 30m, toggle on for prod for 1 hour to validate.

maria_m: please also update the handoff playbook with steps for revops -> sdR and a one-line snippet to revert.

raj_s: I'll prepare the workflow + SF mapping patch. pinging TJ for canary: @tj_oncall

tj_oncall: on it. schedule canary for west-1 only first, will monitor SLA, slack alert if >5% unassigned.

olivia_r: thanks team. post-deploy action: collect sample lead ids and confirm owner fields reconcile across HS/SF.

maria_m: adding checklist to playbook now. :white_check_mark:

enrich-bot: deploy triggered by noah_e at 2428002100, status: in_progress

enrich-bot: deploy success at 2428002460, flag: fallback_assigned=true

raj_s: flipped HS workflow live. monitoring.

olivia_r: early look — unassigned count dropped to ~12 in last 30m. Good.

maria_m: will file a retro and map root-cause: schema rename + missing mapping tests.

noah_e: adding unit test and integration test for schema edgecases, will open PR now.

olivia_r: cheers. I'll notify SDR leads and update handbook.
